member.name: F:SysWeaver.DecompressParams.Overwrite
member.summary: If true, existing destination files are overwritten, else they are skipped

member.name: F:SysWeaver.DecompressParams.Once
member.summary: If true, only one compressed version of a file is decompressed (ex: if both "a.txt.br" and "a.txt.zstd" exists, only one of them is decompressed, using the Prefer order)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.DecompressParams.Prefer
member.summary: The order of preference when using Once (http codes like zstd, br, gzip, deflate), any other supported compression method is less preferred

member.name: F:SysWeaver.DecompressParams.ExtOrder
member.summary: All supported file extensions (with a "." prefix) in order of preference

member.name: F:SysWeaver.DecompressProgram.ExitDecompressFailed
member.summary: Exit code: a file couldn't be decompressed (invalid or truncated data).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.DecompressProgram.GetPreferredExt(System.String,SysWeaver.DecompressParams)
member.summary: Get the file extension (with a "." prefix) of the preferred compressed version of a file (using Once)
member.param: The file name without the compression extension
member.returns: The extension of the preferred compressed version that exists, or null if none exist
